text.tspan: I keep hearing the same metaphor, offered as
though it were simply how things are:
attention is a resource, spent like currency,
and the discipline of a life is mostly a…

text.tspan: Pay attention, we say, as if the paying settled
something—as if the mind kept a ledger,
and the ledger, once emptied, simply closed

'JetBrains Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

text.tspan: Picture the gut, not the wallet—the figure
worth carrying is a long, coiled, patient
organ that does not care how much arrives
at once so much as what it is asked to break…

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace
'JetBrains Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace
'JetBrains Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

text.tspan: A wallet has one operation: subtraction. A
gut has dozens—it selects, it ferments, it
refuses, it stores, it converts one thing into
another thing entirely, and none of this…
